searchText: Hi, is the devnet network undergoing stress testing now? The gas has not dropped for a long time. Also, is there any rpc method to get the blob gas price? Yeah, its being spammed with tx and blobs i can stop it if its needed Could you keep it going for an hour at least, want to test estimation sure, ill leave it alone 🙂 Thanks! Seems working!
